description:
Fetch NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD). Today's by default, or any date from 1995-06-16 onwards. Returns title, explanation, media URL (+ HD variant), copyright. Uses DEMO_KEY by default; set NASA_API_KEY env for higher rate limits.

upAPI operation `nasa-apod.get` (Media). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today. Must be on or after 1995-06-16.
date.title: Date

name: nasa_apod_get
title: Get NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
